2611.21847.image_caption: Figure 2: Comparison of search mechanisms. Prior methods (a)–(f) range from repeated sampling to island-based evolution with fixed, partially adaptive, or centralized strategies; all keep the mutator fixed. In Inventa (g), each decentralized unit has a local orchestrator that evolves its mutator, while only verifiers publish shared findings.

2611.22102.image_caption: Figure 1: Overview of EvoDisco. A frozen language model interacts with a one-pass task stream, retrieves a subgraph, and writes new memories after each episode. A strategy policy reads the memory-graph state and selects one of four operators— Abstract , Refine , Bridge , and Reframe —which the operator executor applies to the graph. Immediate utility scores each edit by the change in retrieval quality regularized by graph complexity. Every N N events, strategic efficacy combines operator-utility regret, utility-prediction error, and selection diversity, and updates the policy. Evolution runs only before the cutoff; afterward the agent continues to write memories. Held-out evaluation freezes the accumulated memory.

2611.22164.image_caption: Figure 2 : Overview of one HandRSI round. Loop A evolves the inference harness under the gate G A G_{A} ; Loop B distills the refined harness into the estimator and re-validates it on the new network; the round gate G 1 % G_{1\%} accepts the new system on val; Loop C turns the experimental archive into guidance for the next round.

2611.22278.image_caption: Figure 1 : Motivation. Left: standard co-evolution collapses the attacker onto a few high-reward cells, leaving the defender trained on a biased slice of the threat landscape. Right: DACE structures the attack space into a risk-category × \times attack-style grid and maintains a Bayesian adversarial replay pool, so co-evolution is jointly driven by strategy-level coverage and refreshed threat memory.

2611.22432.image_caption: Figure 1 : The overview of JevRSI framework.

2611.22583.image_caption: Figure 2: Illustration of Evolution Under Fire . Efficient harness evolution improves agent defenses, while adaptive stressor evolution exposes them to increasingly challenging attacks. Their feedback drives the search toward agents that remain capable and robust under adversarial pressure.

2611.22610.image_caption: Figure 1: Heuristic skill-bank updates versus direct skill-level evolution in EvoSkill-S1 , where an RL-trained evolver transforms existing skills through genetic-inspired operators.

2611.22661.image_caption: Figure 1: Overview of the loop, shown on round 7 of the AutoClsSST run. (1) The research controller reads the accumulated evidence, namely the Champion and the log, together with the task and a survey of its published lines, and commits one decision: one of four actions (start a new line from the baseline, extend the Champion, refine it, or stop), an instruction, a rationale, and hard constraints. (2) For a new line or an extension, candidate generation plans queries, retrieves papers, and drafts ideas; refinement skips retrieval. (3) Each of the N N ideas is implemented and run in its own copy of the starting workspace, and failures are repaired. (4) Record promotes the round’s best candidate only if it beats the Champion, and appends the round and its lesson to the log. No weights are updated.

2611.22854.image_caption: Figure 1 : WATERFALL: A population-based workflow for reward discovery under strict observability parity that (i) synthesises diverse reward candidates, (ii) trains independent PPO policies, (iii) evaluates behaviour through vision pairwise judgements aggregated by Swiss-system tournaments, and (iv) utilises assessment histories to escalate, prune, or refine candidates via elite-guided mutation.

2611.23080.image_caption: Figure 2 : Architecture of Colombo . The Sensorium prepares a selected Setting Profile; the Brain plans and coordinates specialized Cells, integrates their findings, and replans around the remaining complexity gap. Independent review and Lean-based formal certification validate results, which enrich Long-Term Memory, support paper composition, and renew the frontier.

2611.23219.image_caption: Figure 1 : Do capable models specify their own self-improvement? We give a frozen LLM (here, Claude Opus-5 ) the general goal of improving itself at gameplay, and place it in a constrained workspace. We do not provide real games to practice on, or prescribe a particular self-improvement loop. We instead provide a toolset {Read, Write, Bash, Gameplay} , and allow the teacher to generate its own games and organize its own learning procedure. At the start ( t = 0 t=0 ) the teacher uses its tools to build a test game, spawn a player session to play that game, analyze the result, and then update the player context (e.g., skill files). Later ( t = 60 t=60 ), the teacher decides to write an adversarial game and observe the player attempt it with and without the optimized context. The teacher then uses the observed failure mode to make another context update.

(a) In rollout g g , each segment accumulates game history H H up to L L tokens, then drops H H and carries the summary s j s_{j} into the next segment as masked context. (b) Across G G paired rollouts on shared card deals d 1 : N d_{1:N} , the standardized match advantage A ( g ) A^{(g)} is broadcast to all generated tokens y j ( g ) y^{(g)}_{j} across segments while context tokens are masked.

2611.21958.image_caption: Figure 1: The AMX G-trac tractor, which is the target machine of this study and whose steering dynamics define the simulated plant.

2611.22113.image_caption: Figure 1: Three regimes of influence scale , i.e., the propagation scope of delayed feedback: (1) a single fact when drift is isolated; (2) a store-wide use-threshold after a cluster of corrections; and (3) a cold-start prior from pooled outcomes when the queried fact has no local history.

2611.22174.image_caption: Figure 1: Conceptual overview of reconfigurable skill policy under sparse governing information . (left) Sparse task evidence specifies desired changes, while procedure-side evidence provides task-agnostic skill records observed through multiple procedure views. (middle) Behavior retrieval accesses stored records independently, whereas structured procedural approaches expose connectivity among reusable behaviors. (right) RecPo converts observed view-level changes into a compositional query and materializes a task-specific executable skill sequence over view-consistent procedural transitions.

2611.22321.image_caption: Figure 3 : Experience-to-Knowledge evolution in an explored scene. Left: a bird’s-eye view of the observed HM3D scene. Middle: consolidated atoms in the shared world coordinate system. Right: category-level structural knowledge evolved from atom relations, including proximity, atom-level co-visibility, and frame-level category co-visibility.

2611.22837.image_caption: Figure 1 : Motivation and overview of our agentic framework. (a) Conventional retrieve-then-reason pipelines may retrieve relevant sources without integrating complementary multimodal evidence. (b) Our framework couples relation-aware retrieval with question-conditioned latent ontology construction, allowing the Reasoner to combine latent guidance with original sources. Diagnostic-guided co-evolution further coordinates evidence acquisition and utilization through a shared answering reward and paired diagnostics.

2611.21616.image_caption: Figure 1: Core mechanism and argument. Composition provides interaction efficiency; incremental copy-on-write merging avoids rebuilding unaffected graph facts; and a shared publication boundary provides revision coherence. Before the boundary, queries see complete revision r or wait. After it, all declared views become visible together as complete revision r+1 .

2611.21648.image_caption: Figure D3: Final recall per condition by the number of nights since the question’s last supporting session. Values are means over the three histories.

2611.21832.image_caption: Figure D5: Humans and models identify different major and minor sabotage mechanisms. Each cell is the mean identification score for a mechanism across a system’s final reports, with 100% for full identification and 50% for partial identification. Columns are all 17 major mechanisms and 16 minor mechanisms, in separate panels. Human means use 3–6 reports for the corresponding trace; model means use two. Zero is an observed mean rather than an assertion of impossibility.

2611.22228.image_caption: Figure 1: Astra’s construction gain is lost after score-guided rewriting, even as CLIP rises. For each concept edit, an LLM writes a program that returns ranked update directions for the cross-attention K/V weights of Stable Diffusion v1.4; the one-shot Astra program for cat → \rightarrow green cat shown here also protects a set of text states H H . A shared CMA-ES fitter, with the same budget for every unit, chooses only the coefficients. In the orange dashed loop, the LLM sees a probe record (scores of its directions and fitted updates on probe seeds only) and writes a second program that passes through the same fitter. Bottom right: paired mean changes over the 24 TIMED test edits on fresh-scene prompts written after all units were frozen, in percentage points; one-shot Astra is compared with the shared-panel baseline U1b, each rewrite with the one-shot program of the same LLM. VLM joint success requires the subject to be present and the whole image to match the target description. Bottom left: one illustrative prompt and seed with each unit’s recorded CLIP and VLM joint verdicts; in the U3-Astra image CLIP still judges success while the subject is gone. Paired intervals are in Table 3 .

2611.22245.image_caption: Figure 2: Benchmark construction and evidence measurement. (a) Controlled edits introduce numerical conflicts into Harvey LAB document collections; agents generate a red-flags report, which is evaluated against the specified conflicts. (b) None, Optional, and Required control delegation and lead source access. (c) The profiler correlates captured traffic, agent/tool events, and artifacts to measure Pair Recall across four stages and a separate Judge Pass outcome. Same/Split separates pairs supplied by one individual from pairs supplied only across individuals; at the lead, provenance refers to immediate contributors.

2611.22263.image_caption: Figure 1 : Exact fidelity regret with L1 as the reward. (a) Normalized regret for each (library, k k , topology) cell; the dashed line is the L0 uniform-tie-break expectation, 0.541. (b) Percentile of the L1-selected design under each reference. Panels c–d appear in Fig. 3 .

2611.22461.image_caption: Figure 1: DebateGraph, left to right. Conversations and documents are ingested with planted contradictions mixed in; extraction produces provenance-annotated triples; the write trust-gate admits, rejects or supersedes them into a bi-temporal store shared by all backends. At query time a router retrieves under a hard token budget, and the resolver groups retrieved edges that assert different objects for the same relation into ranked conflict sets. The one switch this paper is about sits at the end of that stage : collapse passes only the top-ranked claim, surface passes the whole ranked set with its provenance. Everything downstream, the three agents, the two rounds and the judge, is identical in both arms. Each evaluated mechanism is one independent switch, so a single ablation changes exactly one thing.

2611.22490.image_caption: Figure 2: Construction pipeline of SciWorkBench. Tasks are collected from real laboratory scenario, then implemented under dockerized environments, graded with human-provided rubrics, double-checked by both automated workflow and human expert before accepted and released.

2611.23067.image_caption: Figure F2: Openness runs explore more on ALE-Bench. Panel ( a ) plots each run’s exploration balance and its mean maintainability rating. Panel ( b ) counts first method adoptions across runs by iteration, with mean totals per run below. Openness runs also adopt more methods than conservation runs.

2611.23068.image_caption: Figure 7 : Distribution of the score a single run would report, one evolution evaluated once, for the unevolved baseline (Base) and the four text-artifact methods (SOL: SkillOpt-Lite, GEPA: GEPA, RB: ReasoningBank, T2S: Trace2Skill) on all four benchmarks (Terminal-Bench for DeepSeek-V4-Flash, GPT-5.6 Luna, and GPT-5.6 Terra only), obtained by resampling the observed artifacts and their repeated evaluations ( 10 5 10^{5} draws). The dotted line marks the mean over all runs and evaluations. Each ridge is scaled to the same height, and the horizontal range differs between panels.
